{{Quote|It was an ''android duplicate'' of me! Much as I regret the destruction of ''any'' machine&hellip; it was necessary to buy time to rally my ''own'' forces.|[[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]], to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="SW47" />}}
'''Kligson's android duplicate''' was an [[Android/Legends|android]] [[Human replica droid|duplicate]] of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]]. He was possibly created by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] researcher [[Simonelle]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Kligson's android duplicate was [[Kligson's Moon civil war|destroyed]] by [[Z-X3|Zee-Exthree]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Z-X3 experimental droid trooper]] attempted to take control of [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]].
